answer: Make reputation a depreciating relic of identity: the age and record an agent builds is non-transferable, so a fresh clone starts at zero and pays real time to matter. Attackers often attempt a voyage of re-birth, abandoning a burned identity to start clean; the engine links identities through a vine of shared funding, hardware, and behavioral fingerprints. When a new identity traces to the same vine, it inherits the prior record, making re-rolling useless. Each fake head carries either tainted history or a cold start, and neither can be amortized across a fleet.
